def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def blob(b): return hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()
def git(ref,path): return subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref+':'+path],cwd=root)
def load(path): return git(packet_ref,path) if packet_ref else (root/path).read_bytes()
reader=report['inverse_reader']['utf8_lf'].encode('utf-8')
assert len(reader)==report['inverse_reader']['bytes']
assert sha(reader)==report['inverse_reader']['sha256'] and b'\r' not in reader
checks=[]
for f in p['sources']:
    path=f['packet']['path']; old=git(p['baseline_ref'],path); new=load(path)
    assert old==git(p['published_ref'],path)==git(p['source45_ref'],path)
    for b,k in [(old,'baseline'),(new,'packet')]:
        q=f[k]; assert len(b)==q['bytes'] and sha(b)==q['sha256'] and blob(b)==q['git_blob']
    steps=[s for s in p['source_seams'] if s['path']==path]
    work=old
    for s in steps:

        assert len(a)==s['before_bytes'] and len(b)==s['after_bytes']
        assert sha(a)==s['before_sha256'] and sha(b)==s['after_sha256']
        assert sha(work)==s['before_step_sha256'] and work.count(a)==1 and work.index(a)==s['offset']
        work=work.replace(a,b,1); assert sha(work)==s['after_step_sha256']
    assert work==new
    for s in reversed(steps):

        assert sha(work)==s['after_step_sha256'] and work.count(b)==1
        work=work.replace(b,a,1); assert sha(work)==s['before_step_sha256']
    assert work==old
    checks.append(dict(path=path,forward_exact=True,reverse_exact=True,sha256=sha(new)))
cpp='src/native_gui_text_glyph_quad_storage.cpp'
old=git(p['baseline_ref'],cpp); new=load(cpp)
a=re.findall(rb'__asm[ \t\r\n]*\{[^}]*\}',old)
b=re.findall(rb'__asm[ \t\r\n]*\{[^}]*\}',new)
assert a==b and len(b)==22

assert old.count(b'__COUNTER__')==new.count(b'__COUNTER__')==3

    assert sha(actual)==f['sha256'] and blob(actual)==f['git_blob']
assert report['credits']['new_original_bodies']==0 and report['readiness']['activation']==False
